name: CKEditor5 block embed
description: A CKEditor 5 toolbar button and text-format filter that embed content blocks, view blocks, and the active theme's region blocks into body content.
provides_plugin_types: ck5_block_embed (custom embed-render plugin type; manager plugin.manager.ck5_block_embed, annotation @Ck5BlockEmbed, namespace Plugin/Ck5BlockEmbed; core plugins content_block, view_block, theme_block)
project_description: The CKEditor5 Block Embed module adds an "Embed Block" toolbar button and a companion "Embed blocks" text-format filter that let editors place three kinds of block into body content: content blocks (block_content entities), view blocks (a view's block display), and region/theme blocks (block config entities placed in the active theme). The button opens a modal dialog that lists the available blocks and, on submit, inserts a placeholder element (<ck5-block-embed data-plugin-id data-plugin-config data-button-id>) into the markup. At display time the filter parses that element, instantiates the matching embed plugin, and renders the referenced block, view, or region block. Because the reference is resolved on render, updating the underlying block updates every field that embeds it. The toolbar button is gated by the 'use ck5 block embed button' permission (removed from the editor JS settings for users who lack it). The module ships no configuration UI of its own beyond enabling the filter and toolbar button on a text format at /admin/config/content/formats.
